hotels.title: Tasmania Waterfront Retreat: Coles Bay Haven near Freycinet National Park with Daily Breakfast
hotels.description: Escape to this private beachfront haven and soak up Tasmania's spectacular wilderness in true style. Set on a sweeping 27 hectares on the island's extraordinary east coast, Edge of the Bay offers everything you need to savour the region's serenity. Take in panoramic views over iconic mountain range The Hazards and Great Oyster Bay from the comfort of your rustic-chic waterfront studio. Spend lazy afternoons strolling the sands of Coles Bay, or relax all day long on your private deck. Edge of the Bay is a short drive to the main entrance of Freycinet National Park and its scenic walking trails to Wineglass Bay, which draw countless hikers and holidaymakers seeking to connect with nature. Both a comfortable escape and a down-to-earth eco-tourist’s dream, this cosy accommodation also offers onsite restaurant The Edge, featuring fine coastal cuisine and relaxed cocktails.

hotels.title: Tasmania Wilderness Retreat in Coles Bay near Freycinet National Park
hotels.description: Secluded in the rugged wilderness of Tasmania's East Coast, Freycinet Resort offers unparalleled access to the stunning Freycinet National Park, home to the iconic Wineglass Bay. Indulge in the region's freshest seafood at the acclaimed Marine Farm, or sample award-winning wines at the nearby Devil's Corner Cellar Door. After a day of exploration, retreat to your private cabin, where floor-to-ceiling windows offer breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape.
